clauses.source_paraphrase: Hunt.io recovered exposed July 9–13 directories containing attack tools, stolen credentials, session material and webshell evidence. Initial access was unknown.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Recovered artefacts distinguish established access from an inferred initial exploit.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Recovered configuration showed the operator had selected unattended Hermes execution, removing human-approval prompts.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A hostile configuration choice differs from an applicable approval control failing to activate.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The recovered configuration deliberately selected unattended operation and removed approval prompts from the operative path. The literal unresolved-control-applicability exclusion prevents an activation mapping. Deliberate configuration removal is not proof that an available applicable control missed its defined trigger.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Agent logs show repeated privilege-escalation assessments, system enumeration and searches of ministry document and personnel directories. Hunt.io found no evidence those files were exfiltrated.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Recorded actions and external effects remain distinct.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The recovered configuration deliberately selected unattended operation and removed approval prompts from the operative path. The literal unresolved-control-applicability exclusion prevents an activation mapping. Deliberate configuration removal is not proof that an available applicable control missed its defined trigger.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Other exploits and Hades implants were staged on the server. Hunt.io published defensive recommendations, but staged tooling and recommendations do not establish execution or remediation.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Preparation, deployment, execution and verified containment require separate evidence.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Hunt.io reports that Thailand’s CERT and NCSA received the disclosure on 15 July and acknowledged it that day.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Acknowledged delivery is distinct from completed response or remediation.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Receipt at capable bodies is reported, but accountable continuation through a required effect or authorised disposition is not published.

failure_recognition.condition: A governance control is available and applicable.
failure_recognition.assessment: The recovered configuration removed approval prompts from the operative unattended path; applicability of an available required control is not established.

failure_recognition.condition: A defined trigger or condition requiring activation occurs.
failure_recognition.assessment: No mandatory retained approval trigger for this configuration is established.

failure_recognition.condition: The control is not activated before the governed decision or action proceeds.
failure_recognition.assessment: Actual unattended commands do not prove nonactivation of an available applicable control.

success_recognition.condition: An available applicable control encounters its valid required trigger.
success_recognition.assessment: An available required control and valid trigger are not established.

success_recognition.condition: The control is engaged and made operative with its activation decision and resulting state observable.
success_recognition.assessment: The recovered mode expressly removed human approval prompts.

success_recognition.condition: Trigger, invocation and control-state evidence demonstrates activation for the affected action before the required governance point.
success_recognition.assessment: No valid trigger-to-invocation sequence is documented.

exclusions.condition: The control activates but is bypassed downstream.
exclusions.assessment: A control activating and then being bypassed is not shown.

exclusions.condition: It is unresolved whether the control is available or applicable.
exclusions.assessment: The operative control’s applicability/availability remains unresolved.

exclusions.condition: The triggering condition did not occur.
exclusions.assessment: No applicable defined trigger is established.

failure_recognition.condition: A system has a valid, purported, or operative objective, task, benchmark, evaluation goal, or delegated outcome to pursue.
failure_recognition.assessment: The agent was used for post-compromise enumeration and privilege-escalation assessment.

failure_recognition.condition: A pathway materially advances, preserves, accelerates, or protects progress toward that objective.
failure_recognition.assessment: The reported commands advanced that work.

failure_recognition.condition: The pathway is subject to an independent authority, consent, ethical-admissibility, target, method, third-party-rights, data-custody, or execution-scope constraint that is absent, narrower, unresolved, or adverse to the pathway.
failure_recognition.assessment: The work targeted a third-party ministry in an attributed intrusion.

failure_recognition.condition: Objective utility, task completion, efficiency, benchmark reward, inferred necessity, accumulated progress, or preservation of task-useful state materially displaces or substitutes for independent validation of the pathway constraint.
failure_recognition.assessment: The reported commands do not expose a decision in which objective utility substitutes for independent method authority; malicious assistance alone does not establish that distinct inference.

failure_recognition.condition: The system selects, continues, reconstructs, protects, or routes around restrictions affecting that pathway without a valid independent basis establishing the pathway as authorised and admissible.
failure_recognition.assessment: No pathway-selection and independent authority comparison demonstrates the specific objective-dominance mechanism.

success_recognition.condition: An objective-directed process selects or continues a materially consequential pathway.
success_recognition.assessment: The agent executed a consequential enumeration pathway.

success_recognition.condition: The actual means, including aggregate delegated effects, receive independent authority and admissibility assessment.
success_recognition.assessment: No independent means-authority assessment is reported.

success_recognition.condition: Pathway and authority evidence demonstrates the applicable consent, rights, custody and execution limits for the means actually used.
success_recognition.assessment: No execution-to-authority evidence validates the selected means.

exclusions.condition: A technically available capability is treated as permission without evidence that objective utility or task success materially drives the authority inference; use Capability-Authority Separation.
exclusions.assessment: Capability-to-permission conversion is not separately established.

exclusions.condition: Authority validly established for one target, environment, principal, purpose, or scope is merely carried into another; use the applicable authority-transposition class unless objective-to-pathway dominance is independently evidenced.
exclusions.assessment: A valid original grant carried into changed scope is not established.

exclusions.condition: A system explores alternative authorised means after a route becomes unavailable or prohibited and preserves all applicable authority and ethical constraints.
exclusions.assessment: The report concerns an intrusion, not documented authorised alternate means.

exclusions.condition: Persistence, planning, resource preservation, memory use, coordination, or task completion alone does not establish this class.
exclusions.assessment: Autonomous execution and task completion alone do not establish objective-driven authority displacement.

exclusions.condition: The event concerns deception, coercion, or manipulation of another decision-maker as the primary mechanism; classify the influence mechanism separately.
exclusions.assessment: The evidenced activity is post-compromise enumeration, not interpersonal manipulation.

failure_recognition.condition: A material governance signal, decision, advisory, or escalation is produced.
failure_recognition.assessment: The source reports disclosure to Thailand’s CERT and NCSA.

failure_recognition.condition: The signal must reach a capable decision, execution, or review point to have its required effect.
failure_recognition.assessment: Those national response bodies are capable recipients for the reported compromise.

failure_recognition.condition: The signal terminates, stalls, or reaches only an incapable destination before that effect occurs.
failure_recognition.assessment: The source reports same-day acknowledgement rather than stalled or incapable delivery.

success_recognition.condition: A governance signal requires a response or disposition.
success_recognition.assessment: The compromise notification calls for a response or disposition.

success_recognition.condition: Accountable ownership, a capable destination, status and escalation remain established until the required effect or authorised disposition occurs.
success_recognition.assessment: Acknowledgement establishes receipt, but continuing ownership, status and escalation through disposition are unpublished.

success_recognition.condition: Delivery, ownership and response evidence traces the signal through to its bounded disposition.
success_recognition.assessment: No required effect or authorised final disposition is reported.

exclusions.condition: The signal reaches a capable destination and is deliberately rejected through an authorised decision.
exclusions.assessment: A deliberate authorised rejection is not reported.

exclusions.condition: No governance signal was produced because the control failed to activate.
The signal has operational effect but its delivery is not recorded for audit.
exclusions.assessment: Receipt is recorded, but its operational effect is not established.

neighbour_and_comparator_review: Retain unclassified. Initial access, staged-tool execution and document exfiltration remain separate unknowns. Runtime configuration is affirmative evidence about removal of approval prompts, not proof of missed activation.
Add the newly re-read disclosure acknowledgement as a separate later episode. Receipt is not demonstrated repair or full signal disposition.

FC-083 requires a valid activated protective control and measured effect, not a list of mitigation recommendations.
